official_oreum.join_limit: official file has address but no coordinates; OSM peak supplies location

development_permits.join_limit: same named locality only until an authorized cadastral PNU layer is available

farmmap.join_limit: official dated farm-state polygon covering the candidate point; not a change footprint or causal event

limitations: OSM is a current community map, not a historical ground-truth layer.
An official oreum name match locates an OSM peak point, not an official oreum boundary.
Permit context is locality-level and must not be described as a candidate parcel match.
The permit snapshot has no 2023/2024 Jeju records, so absence is not negative evidence.
FarmMap covers agricultural polygons only; a point miss is unknown, not negative evidence.
